node_definition.done_when: Done when. A timing measure on the fleet node, against the real store and the real reckon project, runs five real dispatches that are queued and five dry runs, each from the main checkout and from a worktree. Each queued request is held as it is created and dropped once its time is taken, and the evidence shows none launched. It records the load average and the project-discovery share beside each wall time, and every wall time is under ten seconds. A test with a temporary repository runs a batch of entries naming three plans from a worktree and counts one project derivation. The existing dispatch refusal tests pass unchanged. Negative control: the same measure at the base revision records wall times over ten seconds and the discovery share above 80 percent, and the batch test counts two derivations; both failing runs are logged to docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/s21.html . The timing runs on the fleet node because it measures what coordinators wait for there; the tests run on all_debug .
node_definition.goal: make a dispatch of one section answer in under ten seconds by removing project-discovery cost from the dispatch path
